head: 44a1121e4028a9d614343aebd56ffe71ea128b11
scope: Finite independent read-only review of three cover cookbook pages, written core/model examples and cover-recipes ledger; final visible role labels only

semantic_checks.evidence: Actual Front Cover label maps to CoverFront; folderpath already carries the separator and host paths are relative per file or absolute for shared image. Delete off adds while delete on clears all artwork; invalid image validation precedes removal, with later write failure/multifile non-atomic bounds stated. Repeated ID3 cover imports receive identifying descriptions in describe_repeated_cover, consistent with can add another picture. Wildcard example uses first importable natural/case-insensitive filename candidate, skips invalid image/folder and does not expand folder globs.

Maximum compares longer dimension and preserves images within limit in all scaling modes; Minimum compares shorter side and may enlarge. Proportional, stretch and center-crop examples match resize_image. adjust_image returns no change when dimensions and output format are unchanged, including quality-only JPEG changes; Original requires a supported writable original format. Action adjusts all embedded images, copies role/description and leaves external folder image untouched.

Managed originals keep image:null and all_files:false; retained front identities remain only where present. Dropping back/leaflet rows removes them, including leaving Archive empty. Apply to all intentionally redistributes the chosen image, adding it alongside the other file front. Presence labels/circles describe membership rather than role or quality; visible Front/Back Cover and Leaflet labels match the actual model.

MP4 normalization explicitly uses Other with no descriptions, so role-based selection cannot discover a front. Manage Remove/Adjust modifies the plan and OK invokes apply_cover_plan; Cancel abandons it. Direct cover Adjust delegates to actionUI.quick(adjust_cover), and action application writes immediately. Save groups persists a workflow, not tags. Read errors, per-file partial failures, recorded session Undo and backup/player/native limits are qualified.

ledger.bounds: 115 local pages and 72 drafts are distinguished from 97 public pages and 90 drafts. Generated MP3/image and model evidence is not described as native UI, all-format storage, device/player compatibility or full canonical parity proof.

independently_executed.provenance: Existing compiled binary supplied by guide owner for final immutable checkpoint; no cold build. Actual marked Markdown settings/cases execute under LF/CRLF using generated MP3/image fixtures and real import/resize/managed-cover core paths.

Exact immutable test, cover-model.ts and recipe strings; temporary loader changes only dependency path and source/document reads. Checks visible role label mapping, retained partial originals, all_files flags, changed plan and actual membership labels.

author_validation_not_repeated.note: Final affected model2 tests passed after visible-role readability edit; full UI count is author preceding validation, not new peer full execution.

limits: No repository edits, source/P2 work, commits, push, publishing, PR/review requests or CI.
No cold/full build, fresh canonical recrawl, native UI, universal format save-back, real player/device or independent browser execution.
Previous local batches are parents, not part of this finite re-review.
Local peer review is not GitHub CODE review or publication/queue authorization.
